finding: The V5 graph sleeve converts a neg-risk event-level sum-to-one constraint projection into standalone single-market directional fair values, even though the structural constraint identifies basket mispricing rather than which individual outcome has positive physical expected value.

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: Both the projected vector and the true-probability vector satisfy the same sum-to-one event constraint. The constraint therefore cannot identify the sign of a single-leg physical expected value; the guaranteed structural trade is the complete basket when executable all-in cost is below one.

required_common_sample_experiment: basket-only executable neg-risk arbitrage using all required legs
graph constraints used only as features/priors for an independently calibrated terminal-probability model
abstention when a complete cost-positive basket is unavailable and no independent directional probability exists
metrics: single-leg terminal Brier/log-loss/calibration by time-to-resolution when an independent probability model exists
common-sample executable OOS PnL at 1x/1.5x/2x costs
